requirements.quote: The recommendations and opinions of each Proposer’s previous customers or clients.
requirements.text: Provide recommendations and opinions from previous customers or clients.

requirements.quote: Information provided in response to specific questions and requirements contained in the RFP and all attachments/exhibits.
requirements.text: Respond to all specific questions and requirements in the RFP and its attachments.

requirements.quote: The proposer’s past experience at the Syracuse Hancock International Airport.
requirements.text: Detail past experience at the Syracuse Hancock International Airport.
Provide information during the interview if required.

requirements.quote: The Proposer must certify in the proposal that its fee covers all services proposed and meets the requirements of this RFP.
requirements.text: Certify that the proposed fee covers all services and meets RFP requirements.

requirements.quote: The total estimated contract value for the services provided will be derived from the successful proposer’s proposed fee.
requirements.text: The contract value will be based on the proposed fee.

requirements.quote: The Committee will evaluate each proposal based on a “Best Value” concept.
requirements.text: Proposals will be evaluated on a 'Best Value' concept.

requirements.quote: The Authority and its review committee will determine which proposal(s) best satisfies its requirements.
requirements.text: The Authority will select proposals that best satisfy its requirements.

requirements.quote: All proposals deemed to be responsive to the requirements of this procurement will be evaluated.
requirements.text: Only responsive proposals will be evaluated.

requirements.quote: Proposals failing to meet the requirements of this RFP may be eliminated from consideration.
Qualified staff/individuals will evaluate all submitted proposals.
The Authority may request clarification of a proposal.
requirements.text: The Authority may ask for proposal clarifications.

requirements.quote: The Authority reserves the right to: (i) withdraw or cancel the RFP at any time and at its sole discretion;
requirements.text: The Authority can cancel the RFP at any time.

requirements.quote: (ii) reject any or all proposals received in response to this RFP;
requirements.text: The Authority can reject any or all proposals.

requirements.quote: (iii) accept a proposal and any subsequent proposal for the contract from someone other than the lowest cost Proposer consistent with the criteria for the evaluation of proposals;
requirements.text: The Authority can accept a proposal not based on lowest cost.

requirements.quote: (iv) make an award under the RFP in whole or in part;
requirements.text: The Authority can make partial or full awards.

requirements.quote: (v) disqualify any proposer whose conduct and/or proposal fails to conform to the requirements of the RFP;
requirements.text: The Authority can disqualify non-conforming proposers.

requirements.quote: (vi) seek clarifications and revisions of proposals;
requirements.text: The Authority can request proposal clarifications or revisions.
